SELECT T2.Country FROM airlines AS T1 JOIN airports AS T2 ON T1.Airline = T2.Airline WHERE T1.Airline = 'JetBlue Airways'
SELECT T2.Abbreviation FROM airlines AS T1 JOIN flights AS T2 ON T1.uid = T2.Airline WHERE T1.Airline = 'JetBlue Airways'
SELECT Airline FROM airlines WHERE Abbreviation = 'UAL'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM airlines WHERE Country = 'USA';
SELECT T2.AirportName FROM airports AS T1 JOIN flights AS T2 ON T1.City = T2.SourceAirport WHERE T1.City = 'Aberdeen'
SELECT T2.AirportName FROM airports AS T1 JOIN flights AS T2 ON T1.City = T2.SourceAirport WHERE T1.CountryAbbrev = 'US' AND T2.DestAirport = 'Aberdeen'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flights WHERE DestAirport = 'ATO'
SELECT T2.AirportCode FROM flights AS T1 JOIN airports AS T2 ON T1.DestAirport = T2.City GROUP BY T2.AirportCode ORDER BY count(*) ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT A.Airline FROM airlines AS A JOIN flights AS F ON A.uid = F.Airline WHERE F.SourceAirport = 'CVO' AND F.DestAirport != 'APG'
SELECT count(*) FROM employee
SELECT City FROM employee GROUP BY City HAVING COUNT(Employee_ID) > 1 AND Age < 30
SELECT LOCATION, COUNT(*) FROM shop GROUP BY LOCATION
SELECT Manager_name, District FROM shop WHERE Number_products = ( SELECT MAX(Number_products) FROM shop )
SELECT T2.District FROM shop AS T1 JOIN evaluation AS T2 ON T1.Shop_ID = T2.Employee_ID WHERE T1.Number_products < 3000 AND T2.Number_products > 10000
SELECT count(DISTINCT LOCATION) FROM shop

SELECT T1.Document_ID, T2.Template_ID, T3.Document_Description FROM Documents AS T1 JOIN Paragraphs AS T2 ON T1.Document_ID = T2.Document_ID JOIN Templates AS T3 ON T2.Template_ID = T3.Template_ID WHERE T1.Document_Name = 'Robbin CV'

SELECT T1.Document_ID, T1.Version_Number, T1.Template_Type_Code FROM Documents AS T1 JOIN Paragraphs AS T2 ON T1.Document_ID = T2.Document_ID JOIN Templates AS T3 ON T2.Paragraph_ID = T3.Paragraph_ID WHERE T3.Template_Type_Code IN ('AD', 'BK')
SELECT COUNT(Template_ID) FROM Templates WHERE Template_Type_Code = 'CV';
SELECT T1.Paragraph_ID, T1.Paragraph_Text FROM Documents AS T1 JOIN Paragraphs AS T2 ON T1.Document_ID = T2.Document_ID WHERE T1.Document_Name = 'Welcome to NY'
SELECT Document_ID FROM Documents WHERE Paragraph_ID IN (SELECT Paragraph_ID FROM Paragraphs GROUP BY Paragraph_ID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2)
SELECT T1.Document_ID, T1.Document_Name FROM Documents AS T1 JOIN Paragraphs AS T2 ON T1.Document_ID = T2.Document_ID GROUP BY T1.Document_ID ORDER BY COUNT(T2.Paragraph_ID) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT Document_ID FROM Documents WHERE Paragraph_ID BETWEEN 1 AND 2
SELECT T2.Name FROM teacher AS T1 JOIN course_arrange AS T2 ON T1.Teacher_ID = T2.Teacher_ID WHERE T1.Hometown != 'Little Lever Urban District'
SELECT T2.Name FROM teacher AS T1 JOIN course_arrange AS T2 ON T1.Teacher_ID = T2.Teacher_ID WHERE T1.Age BETWEEN 32 AND 33
SELECT T2.Town FROM course AS T1 JOIN course_arrange AS T2 ON T1.Course_ID = T2.Course_ID JOIN teacher AS T3 ON T2.Teacher_ID = T3.Teacher_ID GROUP BY T2.Town HAVING COUNT(T3.Teacher_ID) >= 2

SELECT SUM(Total_spent) FROM visit WHERE Level_of_membership = 1
SELECT T1.first_name, T1.birth_date FROM players AS T1 JOIN rankings AS T2 ON T1.player_id = T2.player_id WHERE T1.country_code = 'USA'
SELECT AVG(winner_age) AS avg_winner_age, AVG(loser_age) AS avg_loser_age FROM matches
SELECT ranking_date, COUNT(*) FROM rankings GROUP BY ranking_date
SELECT YEAR(match_num) AS year, COUNT(*) AS matches_played FROM matches GROUP BY YEAR(match_num);
SELECT max(killed) AS max_killed, min(killed) AS min_killed FROM death
SELECT T1.name, T1.result FROM battle AS T1 JOIN death AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.cause_by_ship_id WHERE T1.bulgarian_commander != 'Boril'
SELECT count(*) FROM Courses
SELECT T1.department_name, T1.department_id FROM Degrees AS T1 JOIN Student_Enrolment_Courses AS T2 ON T1.department_id = T2.degree_program_id GROUP BY T1.department_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.section_name, T1.section_description FROM Sections AS T1
SELECT T2.department_name FROM Departments AS T1 JOIN Sections AS T2 ON T1.department_id = T2.department_id WHERE T1.department_name LIKE '%computer%'

SELECT T2.degree_program_id, COUNT(T1.student_id) AS student_count
FROM Student_Enrolment_Courses AS T1
JOIN Courses AS T2 ON T1.course_id = T2.course_id
GROUP BY T2.degree_program_id
ORDER BY student_count DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT T2.semester_name FROM Transcript_Contents AS T1 JOIN Students AS T2 ON T1.student_course_id = T2.student_course_id WHERE T1.transcript_id IS NULL

SELECT T1.transcript_date, T1.student_course_id FROM Transcript_Contents AS T1 JOIN Transcripts AS T2 ON T1.transcript_id = T2.transcript_id WHERE T2.course_id IN (SELECT course_id FROM Transcript_Contents GROUP BY course_id HAVING count(*) >= 2)
SELECT T1.address_id, T1.line_1, T1.line_2 FROM Addresses AS T1 JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T2 ON T1.address_id = T2.degree_program_id GROUP BY T1.address_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T2.section_name FROM Sections AS T1 JOIN Transcript_Contents AS T2 ON T1.section_id = T2.transcript_id WHERE T1.course_id = 1

SELECT Title FROM Cartoon WHERE Directed_by = 'Ben Jones'

SELECT Name FROM poker_player WHERE Earnings > 300000

SELECT Name FROM people WHERE Nationality != 'Russia'
SELECT count(DISTINCT Nationality) FROM people

SELECT COUNT(T1.Name) FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code = T2.CountryCode WHERE T2.Language = 'English' AND T2.IsOfficial = 'T'

```sql

FROM country AS T1
JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code = T2.CountryCode
WHERE T2.Percentage > 72
GROUP BY T1.GovernmentForm;
```
SELECT Language FROM countrylanguage ORDER BY Percentage DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.name, T1.grade FROM Friend AS T1 JOIN Likes AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id JOIN Highschooler AS T3 ON T2.liked_id = T3.id
SELECT ID FROM Highschooler WHERE name = 'Kyle';
SELECT T1.name, COUNT(T2.student_id) FROM Friend AS T1 JOIN Likes AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id GROUP BY T1.name
SELECT T2.name FROM Friend AS T1 JOIN Likes AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id GROUP BY T1.student_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.name FROM Friend AS T1 JOIN Likes AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id WHERE T1.friend_id = (SELECT ID FROM Highschooler WHERE name = 'Kyle')
SELECT COUNT(student_id) FROM Friend WHERE student_id = (SELECT student_id FROM Highschooler WHERE name = 'Kyle')
SELECT student_id FROM Friend WHERE friend_id NOT IN (SELECT student_id FROM Likes)

```sql
SELECT h.name, COUNT(l.liked_id) as like_count
FROM Friend f
JOIN Likes l ON f.student_id = l.student_id
JOIN Highschooler h ON f.friend_id = h.id
GROUP BY h.name;
```

```sql
SELECT T1.name FROM Friend AS T1 JOIN Likes AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id WHERE T2.liked_id > 5 AND T1.friend_id IN (SELECT student_id FROM Friend GROUP BY student_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2)
```
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Likes WHERE student_id = (SELECT student_id FROM Friend WHERE name = 'Kyle')
SELECT T1.name FROM Dogs AS T1 JOIN Owners AS T2 ON T1.owner_id = T2.owner_id WHERE T2.date_adopted < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1000 DAY)

SELECT T1.first_name FROM Professionals AS T1 JOIN Dogs AS T2 ON T1.professional_id = T2.professional_id WHERE T1.first_name NOT IN (SELECT T2.first_name FROM Dogs AS T2 WHERE T2.owner_id = T1.owner_id)

SELECT T1.first_name FROM Professionals AS T1 JOIN Dogs AS T2 ON T1.professional_id = T2.professional_id WHERE T1.first_name NOT IN ( SELECT T2.first_name FROM Dogs AS T2 WHERE T2.owner_id = T1.owner_id )

SELECT T1.role_code, T1.first_name, T1.last_name, T1.email_address FROM Owners AS T1 JOIN Treatments AS T2 ON T1.owner_id = T2.dog_id WHERE T2.treatment_type_code NOT IN (SELECT T3.treatment_type_code FROM Treatments AS T3 JOIN Professional AS T4 ON T3.professional_id = T4.professional_id WHERE T4.role_code = 'Veterenarian')

SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name FROM Professionals AS T1 JOIN Treatments AS T2 ON T1.professional_id = T2.professional_id WHERE T2.treatment_type_code = 'EXAM' AND T2.date_of_treatment < ( SELECT avg(date_of_treatment) FROM Treatments )
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Treatments WHERE dog_id IN (SELECT dog_id FROM Dogs WHERE date_of_treatment BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31')
SELECT T1.name, T1.age, T1.weight FROM Dogs AS T1 JOIN Abandoned_yn AS T2 ON T1.dog_id = T2.dog_id WHERE T2.abandoned_yn = 1
SELECT AVG(age) FROM Dogs

SELECT Citizenship, COUNT(*) FROM singer GROUP BY Citizenship
